sections.title: Recorded incident
sections.note: Internal record. Confirm impact and recovery evidence before sharing.

sections.title: Activity
sections.sql: select actor,action,note,created_at from activity where entity_type='tickets' and entity_id=$1 order by created_at,id

sections.title: Plan and decision
sections.note: An approval record does not execute infrastructure changes.

sections.title: Related open incidents
sections.sql: select t.reference,t.name,t.priority,t.owner from tickets t join changes c on c.service_id=t.service_id where c.id=$1 and t.status in ('open','pending')

sections.title: Incident history
sections.sql: select reference,name,status,resolution from tickets where asset_id=$1 order by opened_at
